The first row, "Would you use a mask even though it is uncomfortable?" shows 93 respondents (72.1%) answered yes, while 8 (6.2%) answered no, and 28 (21.7%) were unsure.

p9_b1.ocr: The second row, "Would you be screened for TB if you had suggestive symptoms?" indicates that 123 participants (95.4%) would agree, 1 (0.8%) would not, and 5 (3.9%) were uncertain.
